description: Return a unified line diff of one text file between two revisions, or between a revision and the workspace copy. Pass changeset to see what that changeset changed in the file. Output longer than 200000 characters is truncated. Read-only.

changeset.description: Changeset spec such as cs:123. Compares the file in that changeset with its parent changeset. Do not combine with from/to.

context.description: Unchanged lines around each change, from 0 to 20. Default: 3.

filePath.description: Path relative to UVCS_WORKSPACE, for example Assets/Scripts/Player.cs.

from.description: Older side: cs:123, lb:LABEL, or a branch such as /main (latest revision on it).

to.description: Newer side: cs:130, lb:LABEL, or a branch. Omit to compare with the file in the workspace.

name: uvcs_revision_diff
